In detail

Bolognina and the northern side of the station — where a lot of Bologna's cheaper hotels are — and the single most heavily policed part of the city. That cuts both ways, and both halves matter. The enforcement is real: in the first half of 2026 police recorded close to 40,000 identity checks and around 120 removal orders in the station and Bolognina area, and reported crime there fell 58.3% year on year, with robberies down 75%, thefts down 74.4% and drug offences down 31.2%. But a decline that steep measures how high the baseline was, and the area is still the one the city assigns extra officers and cameras to. Treat it as an ordinary big-city station district: fine to stay in, worth the usual care at night.

Bologna publishes no comparable neighbourhood-level crime dataset; where a city does publish one, Wandroz uses it instead of an assessment. Where a review finds nothing documented, that is recorded as no findings rather than as a safety rating.

Frequently asked questions

Is Navile safe?

Wandroz currently rates Navile in Bologna as roughly average compared to other neighbourhoods in Bologna during the day and roughly average compared to other neighbourhoods in Bologna at night. This comes from a structured local-source assessment: an area-level review of credible local sources — local and national news, municipal and police-published material, and official surveys where they exist — consolidated across sources rather than taken from a single report. Bologna publishes no comparable neighbourhood-level crime dataset; where a city does, Wandroz uses it instead.

Is Navile safe at night?

At night, Navile is rated as roughly average compared to other neighbourhoods in Bologna. If you're unsure, it's worth checking recent local reviews for your specific street or block, since a neighbourhood-wide rating can't capture block-by-block variation.

Is Navile a good area to stay in as a tourist?

Navile's day rating (roughly average compared to other neighbourhoods in Bologna) is the more relevant one for typical daytime tourist activity; check the night rating too if you'll be out late.
